scope: All 20 supplemental videos, sampled frames 0,20,40,60,80; no claim of continuous-motion acceptance

findings.VP041: Swimming pool and two swimmers retain detail; underwater views do not by themselves verify synchronized water entry.
findings.VP042: Football player and ball are detailed, but requested completed catch is not shown by the sampled frames.
findings.VP043: Yacht, sail and water retain rich detail; sail shape/attachment changes need temporal scrutiny.
findings.VP044: Many recognizable paragliders and cliff landscape, but sequential launch ordering is not established.
findings.VP045: Hands, ropes and hardware are visible, but winch operation and raising of a mainsail are not demonstrated.
findings.VP046: Wrench/hand/beam are recognizable; tool-head changes and the requested socket/bolt operation remain questionable.
findings.VP047: Almost entirely wood-surface texture, without visible hands, separate wooden piece or splintered break. This is a clear content/process omission despite a textured background.
findings.VP048: Foam-like object rests on a ramp; a relatively simple/static scene is appropriate for this caption and is not automatically a failure.
findings.VP049: Bird feet on a rounded surface, rather than a crane machine claw shifting a container. This is a semantic disambiguation failure.
findings.VP050: Hammer and rocks retain detail, but sampled frames do not show clear rock fragmentation/scattering; tool is not clearly a sledgehammer.
findings.VP051: Pool-table texture and balls are present; ball identities/color and the requested collision need denser temporal evidence.
findings.VP052: Legs, ball and grass remain detailed; contact-driven deflection is not proven by sparse frames.
findings.VP053: Globe and hands remain recognizable with map texture; map/appearance changes cannot be accepted as a verified consistent axial rotation from sparse frames.
findings.VP054: Athlete/hand fragments and a tool-like object appear, but the requested hammer-throw process is not clearly represented.
findings.VP055: Bubble at the start, mostly empty background afterward, with a late finger; the requested blow-and-puncture causal sequence is not established.
findings.VP056: Landscape texture is present but many bird-like flying shapes replace the requested arrows and moving target.
findings.VP057: Player, ball and goal are visible; no lamp post is represented, so the requested rebound interaction is missing.
findings.VP058: Gym and people are detailed, but malformed/duplicated limbs and nunchuck-to-bag ripple execution remain problematic.
findings.VP059: Thrower-like figures remain, but javelins become bent, ribbon-like or disconnected shapes.
findings.VP060: Clay bowl and brush retain material detail; completion/uniformity of slip application is not established by sampled frames.

interpretation: The supplemental subset PC3.9 is not evidence that the full goal was met: SA2.85, missing requested processes and several malformed objects remain. Full60 SA3.0/PC3.716667/Joint16. No attribution to physical injection alone before paired comparisons.
